mainEntity.name: What is a Meta Ads agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Meta Ads agency plans, builds, and manages paid advertising across all of Meta's platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and the Audience Network, under one integrated account and funnel strategy rather than treating each placement separately.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Meta Ads agency charge in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on ad spend level and creative production needs. A free audit gives you a specific recommendation based on your industry, current account performance, and goals.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a Meta Ads agency and a Facebook Ads manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: In practice, very little. Meta Ads is the umbrella term for advertising across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and the Audience Network, managed through the same Ads Manager account.

mainEntity.name: Does GrowLimo handle Advantage+ campaigns on Meta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We manage Advantage+ Shopping and Advantage+ Audience campaigns alongside manual, strategy-driven targeting, so automation supports the funnel rather than replacing oversight of it.

mainEntity.name: How does GrowLimo handle iOS tracking issues on Meta Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every account gets Conversions API implementation with server-side event tracking and deduplication, recovering conversion data that browser-only pixel tracking loses after Apple's privacy changes.

mainEntity.name: What Meta Ads placements does GrowLimo manage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Facebook and Instagram feeds, Stories, Reels, Messenger, and the Audience Network, selected and combined based on where your specific audience actually spends time.

mainEntity.name: Does GrowLimo produce Meta Ads creative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Static images, carousels, video scripts, and Reels-format creative are produced in-house as part of Meta Ads management, not billed as a separate service.
